# dsh-ui-zoom-regions

Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
The shell's regions get **independent zoom levels**

instead of one page-wide scale, and the
conversation header's whole bottom edge can be dragged — no

thing is painted there, the cursor just
changes — to make that header shorter or taller.
中文说明 · Install · Controls · How it works
## Regions
| Region | What it zooms | Notes |
| Top | the conversation header: title row (session title, preset badge, header actions) and the vie
w tab row (`Chat` / trajectory / plugin views) | one level for both rows, so every label stays on sc

reen |
| Left | the sidebar column | skipped while the sidebar is collapsed to the icon rail, restor

ed on expand |
| Centre | the conversation body (scroll area + composer) | deliberately **not** the

whole column, so the header above it can never be dragged along |
| Right | the right sidebar column
(files, terminal, browser, document preview …) | independent of the centre column |

Zoom is applied as CSS `zoom` on the target element, so a region keeps its width: content reflows
an
d scales, neighbouring columns are untouched, and the splitter drag handles stay where they are.
## Controls
- `Ctrl` + mouse wheel — zoom **the region under the pointer** (captured, so the page never scrolls)

- `Ctrl` + `+` / `=` — zoom that region in · `Ctrl` + `-` — out · `Ctrl` + `0` — reset it to 100%
-

Range 50 %–200 % for the centre column; the two sidebars (and the header's font) go
**25 %–300 %**;

wheel step 5 %, key/button step 10 %
- The header's **bottom edge** is a second, independent contro

l — **drag it down** to give the
header more room, **drag it up** to collapse it (down to 24 px; a r

ow that no longer fits vanishes
whole, so no line is ever cut in half), **without touching the font*

*; double-click hands the
height back to the stylesheet

The readout in the bottom-right corner shows all four levels. It is hidden by default and only
appea

rs for about two seconds after a change (`pointer-events: none` while hidden, so it never
blocks the

UI). Its last chip cycles the readout mode — auto / always / off — and `Ctrl + Alt + 0`
does the sa
me from the keyboard.
### The header: two independent controls
The conversation header carries **two separate channels** — this is the whole point of 1.2.0:
| | Font size | How much room it takes |
| **Control** | `Ctrl` + wheel / `Ctrl` + `+ -` `0` over the header | drag the header's bottom edge

|
| **Stored in** | `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/levels` (`top`) | `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/headerHeight` (px) |

| **Range** | 25 % – 300 % | 24 px … half the conversation panel |
| **Effect** | title row + tab r
ow scale | `min-height` when growing; `height` plus whole rows dropped when collapsing |

They never interfere: shrinking the labels no longer shrinks the bar, and making the bar taller no
l
onger enlarges the labels.
**The bottom edge.** Its **entire width** is the drag target: an invisible 9 px band just inside the
bottom edge that paints nothing and only switches the cursor to `ns-resize`. No handle to hunt for.

- The pointer moves the edge one pixel per pixel — drag 20 px and the header is 20 px taller or
shor

ter.
- **Dragging up really shrinks it, one whole row at a time.** `min-height` is only a floor: it

can
never make the header shorter than its content, which is why pulling up used to do nothing at al

l.
Below the natural height the plugin writes `height` and drops the rows that no longer fit **whole

**
(`display: none`; the tab row goes first, then the title row) — a row that stays on screen keeps

its own font size, its padding and its share of the layout, and nothing is ever sliced through the
m

iddle of a line. `overflow: hidden` stays on only as a backstop.
- Limits are measured on every drag

: at least **24 px**, at most **half the conversation panel**
(the panel is resolved through `*_cent

erCol`, then the nearest ancestor meaningfully taller than
the header, then the window). The live nu

mbers are recorded as `headerHeight` / `headerLimits`
in the diag receipt.
- **Double-click** return

s the header to the stylesheet's own height (removes the inline
`min-height`, `height` and `overflow

he header to the stylesheet's own height (removes the inline
`min-height`, `height` and `overflow`).
## Install

The package ships plain JavaScript and runs no install scripts, so there is no build-approval step.
## Storage
Everything is local and per browser origin:
| Key | Contents |

| `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/levels` | `{ top, left, center, right }` zoom factors |
| `dsh-ui-zoom-region

s/headerHeight` | the header occupancy in px (absent = the stylesheet height) |
| `dsh-ui-zoom-regio
ns/diag` | a small diagnostic receipt (version, timestamp, which regions resolved, applied zoom valu
es, `headerHeight`, `headerLimits`) |

The readout mode is deliberately session-only: every page load starts in `auto`, so a mode picked
ea
rlier can never lock you out of the readout.
## How it works

`lib/index.js` is an empty host half. All behaviour lives in the browser half, which resolves the
sh

ell's regions from stable hooks — `[class*="_sidebarCol"]`, `[class*="_centerCol"]`,
`[data-rightbar

-col]`, `[class*="_titleRow"]`, `[data-conversation-tabs"]` — and re-resolves them on
a slow interva

l plus a mutation observer, so panels that React re-creates (the right sidebar, the
header after a s

ession switch) get their level re-applied and a target that disappears never leaves a
stale `zoom` b

switch) get their level re-applied and a target that disappears never leaves a
stale `zoom` behind.
## Credit and licence

MIT. The browser half started from `imdeniil/dsh-ui-zoom`
(MIT), which zooms the whole document. Thi

s package reworks it into per-region zoom with its own
grip, persistence and readout; the upstream c
opyright notice is kept in LICENSE.
## 中文说明

给 DeepSeek Harness 的界面做**分区缩放**：不再只有一个整页比例，而是会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文、
右侧面板各自独立；顶栏的**整条下边界**还可以直接拖动，把顶栏调矮或调高——边

界上不画任何东西，
只有鼠标靠近时光标变化。
